# Art Direction - solar-fan-hat-worldcup

## Subject
A fake-live, World Cup-style stadium UGC story where unbearable summer heat turns into comedic relief the moment a solar fan hat comes on. The visual problem is balancing real-product trust with exaggerated TikTok payoff without drifting into either sports-broadcast polish or cheap slideshow ecommerce.

## Palette
- `#08131C` stadium-night ink for the frame shell and CTA contrast
- `#FF8A3D` heat signal for the misery and sweat problem
- `#66E0FF` cooling signal for airflow and relief
- `#F8FBFF` hard-contrast subtitle and UI text
- `#FFE66D` sparse emphasis accent for "hot game day" moments

These colors create a before/after thermal language: orange means oppressive heat, cyan means immediate relief.

## Type personality
- Heading: Arial Black / heavy grotesk feel, blunt and loud like TikTok text
- Body: Arial Bold, clean and readable on phones
- Accent chips: uppercase condensed-feel treatment using letter spacing instead of decorative fonts

The typography should feel like real social-video overlays, not a premium sports brand package.

## Motion character
- Camera behavior: handheld-ish, minor push-ins, no silky corporate smoothness
- Overlay motion: short 8-12 frame pops, fast ease-out, punchy but not chaotic
- Cooling moments: softer settle and wider glide than the heat moments
- Scene transitions: brief fade/pressure release, not flashy 3D transitions

Heat beats should feel compressed and sticky. Cooling beats should feel looser and easier.

## Layout & rhythm
- Eye starts on the human reaction, then lands on the caption slab, then reads the product proof
- Lower-third glass slab anchors the story beats without covering the hat brim/fans
- Cuts stay in 3-5 second TikTok rhythm
- Product close-up gets its own proof scene instead of repeating the same hero layout

## Signature device
The whole piece uses a bespoke **thermal ribbon system**:
- a slanted orange heat ribbon appears while the fan is still unproven
- a mirrored cyan ribbon appears once airflow wins
- both ribbons drift slightly frame to frame, so the whole video feels like temperature pressure changing in real time

This is unique to this piece and ties the comedy gag to the product function.

## Scene Distinctness
- Shot 1 primary subject: miserable fan in packed stadium heat
- Shot 2 primary subject: skeptical reveal of the tiny hat fans
- Shot 3 primary subject: real product close-up proof
- Shot 4 primary subject: putting the hat on and switching it on
- Shot 5 primary subject: visible relief reaction
- Shot 6 primary subject: floating gag in the same seat area
- Shot 7 primary subject: comfortable return-to-seat watching moment
- Shot 8 primary subject: CTA hero with smiling user plus product card

No two adjacent scenes share the same primary subject.

## Anti-references
- Must not look like Amazon feature-image slideshow
- Must not look like generic sports highlight graphics
- Must not look like stock motion-template product ad
- Must not look like purple neon SaaS promo language
- Must not reuse the screen-remote-drone slideshow approach
